Right, it is possible to limit forwarding platforms if only setup from yaml is considered. As you already concluded, discovery is enabled by default. The discovery process is optimized to use a dispatcher to process incoming discovery messages. Now we have dispatchers for all the platforms. The listeners are set up with the platform set up. So to support a Just-in-Time set up we should use a shared dispatcher, the listener for it should check if the platform is set up already and if that is not the case, it should be set up.
thx, please let me know if I can in anyway help out. glad there is something that can be done ;-)
